content: For all PDUs that have been stored for a socket connection using the nPdu feature, SoAd shall call the upper layer with the related transmit confirmation function ( <Up>_[SoAd][If]TxConfirmation>() ) within the context of the SoAd_MainFunction() and with result set to (1) E_OK if the related TcpIp_Ud pTransmit() call was successful, (2) E_NOT_OK if the transmission was not successful or cancelled for any other reason.
